contract: ../DESIGN_CONTRACT.md; ../PHONE_RUNTIME.md. Phone-specific verification uses controlled camera/sensor fixtures, not physical Android hardware.

accessibility.evidence: Camera, sensor retry, pairing and map controls have text labels; error/status regions announce results. Keyboard Tab reached enabled controls with the global visible focus ring. No audio or motion is required to use controls.

responsive.evidence: Rendered phone at 390x844 without horizontal document overflow; desktop permission-state capture at 1440x1000. Camera overlays matched the source-frame coordinates. All sensor values wrap within the layout.

loading.evidence: Triggered location retry with a pending device callback; Requesting permission remained visible while the camera and available model continued running.

empty.evidence: Production-path camera with a blank synthetic frame showed No detections in the current frame after both real models loaded.

error.evidence: Injected camera NotAllowedError and GPS denial; specific permission guidance appeared, no coordinates or acceleration were fabricated.

partial.evidence: Injected a worker constructor failure in the production /MargAI/ preview: pothole model Needs attention, object model Model ready, camera readyState 4. Restoring Worker and Retry models recovered both models.

success.evidence: Real model inference on a road-image synthetic stream produced two pothole boxes and one pedestrian box. Injected GPS and IMU readings appeared with timestamps, zero speed, 1 g and measured rotation. Stop ended all test camera tracks and cleared sensor readings.

permission.evidence: Camera/GPS/motion denial tested in browser and unit tests; UI displayed Permission denied, recovery actions and absent readings.

renderedEvidence.observation: Real on-device model inference on a repository road photo streamed through a synthetic camera. GPS and IMU data are explicit injected verification fixtures, not Android hardware readings.
Desktop rendering of the permission-denied state with no fabricated GPS or IMU values.

limits: Physical Android camera/GPS/motion permissions and accuracy remain unverified until the new build is deployed and opened on the device.
Google Maps authorization remains untested because the user requested integration without a browser key. OpenStreetMap fallback was rendered.
Model photo smoke tests are not an accuracy benchmark.
